text:
Priya Patel: Quick thread — finished the regional sweep for the new 7B-int8 bring-up using the sliding-window + prioritized scheduler. Posting highlights and config we used.

Alice Chen: CSVs uploaded to /bench/2025-03/sliding-window-sweep.csv. TL;DR: H100(us-west) p50=26ms p95=92ms p99=260ms, throughput ~185k tokens/s at 512 max_len.

Mateo Ruiz: EU-west H100 is worse on tail: p95=140ms p99=420ms with same config. APAC h100 p95 sits ~220ms. Looks like regional traffic shape + cold KV cache.

Danilo Silva: Noted a fairness issue — tenants with small concurrency get starved when max_batch_tokens=8192 + priority tilt on. Small qps requests get batched out longer.

Priya Patel: Exact scheduler settings we ran (for reference):
```json
{
  "batch_window_ms": 12,
  "max_batch_tokens": 8192,
  "priority_decay_ms": 2000,
  "coalesce_threshold": 0.65,
  "kv_cache_policy": "warm-prefix-only",
  "kernel_preference": ["flash_attn_v2","triton_fused"]
}
```

Alice Chen: Experiment: drop batch_window_ms -> 6ms and max_batch_tokens -> 4096. Result: p99 down ~35% (was 260ms -> 170ms on us-west) but throughput dips ~7% (185k -> 172k tokens/s). Tail improved at cost of unit efficiency.

Mateo Ruiz: Kernel notes: flash_attn_v2 wins on H100 for 1..2k token windows; triton_fused better on A100 for larger batch-token mixes. We saw A100 throughput +10% using triton_fused with max_batch_tokens=8192.

Danilo Silva: Re: fairness, adding a decay on priority and a small per-tenant min-window helped. Config suggestion: priority_decay_ms=1500 and tenant_min_window_ms=4. That reduced starvation events by ~80% in simulation.

Priya Patel: Quality/regression check: quant int8 vs fp16 — we ran 200 eval prompts. Average EM/R@1 difference <0.8% for generic prompts, but code-gen cases dropped ~2.4% in exact match. Need to flag for model team before full rollout.

Alice Chen: Attached a couple of charts — latency CDFs per region and token-rate vs GPU-util. Observed GPU util on H100 ~72% steady at our default batch params; dropping window to 6ms reduced util to ~63%.

Mateo Ruiz: Capacity sizing note: for production with p95 <120ms target and 20% headroom, recommend 1 H100 per 220k sustained tokens/sec for this model/config in us-west. EU/APAC need +25% at baseline due to colder cache/longer RTTs.

Danilo Silva: Rollout plan suggestion: canary on us-west (10% traffic) with reduced batch_window_ms=6 and priority_decay_ms=1500, keep EU/APAC on current config until we add tenant_min_window. If p99 stays <200ms after 24h we widen.

Priya Patel: Action items:
- Alice: finalize dashboard tiles and upload the per-tenant starvation run (due EOD).
- Mateo: run A100 kernel sweep with triton_fused presets (low batch_window + high max_batch_tokens) and paste numbers here.
- Danilo: add tenant_min_window toggle to scheduler + perf test.

infra-bot: Benchmark run complete: run_id=run-20250331-1748, artifacts -> https://internal.redwood/bench/run-20250331-1748, summary: p50/p95/p99 per-region CSVs uploaded.

Alice Chen: Acknowledged, will drop the CSV link in the ticket and kick the A100 sweep now.

Priya Patel: Thanks — we'll sync tomorrow at 10am to decide canary timing. :thumbsup:
